title: Permission to attack Ares
intro: Diomedes explains his obedience; Athena now orders him to attack Ares and takes the reins herself.

notes.text: δέος, fear (neut); ἀκήριος, spiritless / disabling here. ἴσχει, holds back; Athena's alternative to fatigue.
ἔκγονος, descendant / son; δαΐφρων, warlike / skilled in war: gen sg; Οἰνεΐδης, son of Oeneus, i.e. Tydeus.
ἀπαμείβομαι, reply: pres mid ptc nom sg.
“I recognize you”; Athena had earlier enabled him to distinguish gods from mortals.
τώ, therefore; τοι = σοι; προφρονέως, readily / frankly here.
ἐρέω, I will tell: epic fut of speaking. ἐπικεύθω, conceal: 1sg fut act, negated.
Hesitation / reluctance; another possible reason for holding back, rejected by Diomedes.
μιμνήσκω / μιμνήσκομαι: 1sg perf mid/pass, “I remember,” + gen. σέων = σῶν, possessive; ἐφετμή, command.
ἐπιτέλλω, enjoin / command: 2sg aor act.
ἐάω, permit: 2sg impf, negated. μάκαρ, blessed: dat pl; ἀντικρύ, face to face / directly against.
ἔρχομαι: epic 3sg 2aor subj, -ῃσι = -ῃ; “if Aphrodite comes into battle.”
οὐτάω, wound / stab: epic inf in -μεν, used as a command; Diomedes quotes Athena's exception.
τοὔνεκα = τοῦ ἕνεκα, therefore; ἀναχάζομαι, draw back: 1sg pres mid.
Epic aor pass inf, “gather / crowd together” (εἴλω / ἀλέω); after ἐκέλευσα, with Ἀργείους as subject.
κοιρανέω, command / direct: pres ptc acc sg with Ares; ἀνά + acc μάχην, “through the battle.”
χαρίζομαι, please / gratify: perf mid/pass ptc voc sg; “dear to my heart,” dat θυμῷ.
δείδω, fear: 2sg perf act imperative with present sense; “fear neither Ares nor any other…”
Helper / supporter; Athena's support warrants the changed instruction.
ἔχω: 2sg pres imperative, “drive straight at Ares first”; ἐπί + dat of target.
μῶνυξ, solid-hoofed / single-hoofed: acc pl with horses.
τύπτω, strike: 2sg aor imperative; σχεδίην adv., at close quarters.
ἅζομαι, stand in awe of / shrink before: uncontracted 2sg pres mid imperative; θοῦρος, impetuous.
τυκτός, fashioned / made: “evil embodied.” ἀλλοπρόσαλλος, changing sides / fickle (ἄλλο…πρὸς ἄλλο).
πρῴην, lately / the other day; στεῦμαι, profess / promise: unaugmented 3sg impf, στεῦτο; ἀγορεύω pres ptc, speaking.
μάχομαι fut mid inf, fight; ἀρήγω fut act inf, help. Both + dat: against Trojans, for Argives.
ὁμιλέω, associate / move among: 3sg pres. λανθάνομαι / λήθομαι, forget: 3sg perf mid/pass + gen τῶν, “those [promises].”
ὠθέω, push: 3sg aor; χαμᾶζε, to the ground; ἀφ᾽ ἵππων, from the chariot.
ἐρύω, pull: aor act ptc nom fem sg; “pulling him back with her hand.”
ἐμμαπέως, promptly / eagerly; ἀπορούω, spring away: unaugmented 3sg aor (not ἀπορέω).
δίφρος, chariot; παραί = παρά, + acc, beside Diomedes.
ἐμμέμονα, be eager: perf act ptc nom fem sg; compare μεμαυῖα.
βράχω, roar / creak: 3sg 2aor. φήγινος, oak-wood; ἄξων, axle. Its burden is explained next page.
